Reduce Xfiber tracks to vectors connecting the two endpoints

Source: R/find_track_ends.R
find_track_ends.Rd

This function finds the (x, y, z) coordinates of the starting and ending points of an Xfiber tracks object read by `read_xfiber_xml()`.

Usage

find_track_ends(Tracks)

Arguments

Tracks

data.frame: Object containing the full set of tracks and a column for `muscle`, which is required by `coords_to_ternary()`.

Value

tibble: `Tracks` but reduced to one row per track.

Examples

D <- read_xfiber_xml(system.file("extdata",
                     "AV069_SC.xml",
                     package = "MuscleTernary")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(muscle = "SC")
ends <- find_track_ends(D)
